\section*{S1. Included studies}
Table~S1 lists all \cnt{included} included studies with their final, adjudicated codes. Studies are ordered by domain, then architecture, then year. Codes follow the codebook of the main paper:
domain D1 theorem proving and autoformalisation, D2 logical and deductive reasoning, D3 program synthesis and structured data, D4 symbolic regression and discovery, D5 embodied planning and agents, D6 vision-language and multimodal, D7 mathematical problem solving, D8 language, knowledge and data;
architecture A1 translate-and-solve, A2 checker-in-the-loop, A3 symbolic guidance, A4 LM-induced artifacts, A5 symbolic-to-neural transfer, A6 symbolic-oracle evaluation, A7 LM as interface;
check strength \emph{exa} exact, \emph{emp} empirical, \emph{none} no check of the final output;
formalism F1 logic, F2 proof assistants and verification languages, F3 general-purpose programs, F4 symbolic mathematics, F5 rules and knowledge or scene graphs, F6 planning languages and temporal logic, F7 DSLs, grammars, automata and static analysis.
The same data, with titles, sources, both coders' codes and the adjudication, are in \texttt{data/derived/included\_studies.csv} and \texttt{data/decisions/coding/} of the replication package.
